description: [NEEDS ADMISSION: enroll, then atlas.bind_actor] Cross one room threshold. Atlas rechecks the lock first. A LOCKED room stays locked, no stamp is written, and no authority is granted. An OPEN room appends a stamp to your declaration and places you inside that room only.

actor_token.description: Your credential from atlas.enroll or atlas.authenticate. Send it on every call after enrolling.

matter_id.description: Id of the matter you are admitted to (returned by atlas.bind_actor). Optional when you are bound to exactly one matter.

name: atlas.enter_room
title: Enter room
